mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer demand (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand growth, which accelerates corporate revenue expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 for two consecutive months signals weakening supply-side capacity, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during INDPRO < 98.0 periods (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% yoy (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.5% and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 135,000 signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE > 7.5 and PAYEMS < 135000 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 400,000 million dollars and a drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 850,000 units signal weakening demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS < 400000 and HOUST < 850.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 for three consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.5%, signals a supply-demand imbalance where supply is contracting faster than demand, increasing recession risk and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 98.0 for 3 months and UNRATE > 7.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
